item.title: Clarke & Kanu surprise local school in support of 'Our Town Our Top' project
item.description: Pupils at Whitehall Nursery and Infant School were treated to a special surprise visit from Saddlers duo Daniel Kanu and Courtney Clarke. The players met several children inside the school’s library and handed out a number of Walsall FC 2025/26 home shirts as part of Walsall FC Foundation’s 'Our Town Our Top' project.
